claim: Slice 4 of the ADR 0348 follow-up: in apps/api-gateway/src/analytics/analytics.controller.ts GET financial answers a role that does not see money, sales and suppliers withheldForRole and never reads the lens (lensHidden("financial"), GET inventory-science is read withCost: reorderCostReadable(seesFor(user)) so staff get the reorder rows without unit cost, value, EOQ or ABC class, and GET risk passes riskForRole( so vendor and revenue concentration are withheld while demand risk stays; getOverview in advanced-analytics.service.ts applies the same three. Pinned by till-figures-withheld-from-staff.spec.ts, role-reads.spec.ts and reorder-cost-withheld.spec.ts.
verify: python3 -c "import re,sys,pathlib; L=pathlib.Path('apps/api-gateway/src/analytics/analytics.controller.ts').read_text(encoding='utf-8').split('\\n'); S=[i for i,l in enumerate(L) if re.match(r'^\\s*@(Get|Post|Patch|Put|Delete)\\(',l)]; nx=lambda i: min([j for j in S if j>i]+[len(L)]); body=lambda i: '\\n'.join(l for l in L[i:nx(i)] if not l.strip().startswith(('//','*','/*'))); W={'financial':'lensHidden(\"financial\"','inventory-science':'withCost: reorderCostReadable(seesFor(user))','risk':'riskForRole('}; H=lambda r: [i for i in S if re.match(r'^\\s*@Get\\(.'+re.escape(r)+'/:restaurantId',L[i])]; bad=[r for r,w in W.items() if len(H(r))!=1 or w not in body(H(r)[0])]; O=pathlib.Path('apps/api-gateway/src/analytics/advanced-analytics.service.ts').read_text(encoding='utf-8'); bad+=[] if ('lensHidden(\"financial\", sees)' in O and 'riskForRole(riskRead, sees)' in O and 'reorderCostReadable(sees)' in O) else ['overview']; print('OPEN: '+', '.join(bad) if bad else 'HOLDS'); sys.exit(1 if bad else 0)"
